metadata.title: Transfer Pricing Compliance Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the Reptune.net web application (model and data, report generator, workflow and dashboard, CbCR, legal module, benchmarks, administration), to the document outputs clients and tax authorities receive (Word and PDF Master Files and Local Files, Excel data exchange, CbCR XML, EU Public CbCR XHTML with inline XBRL, structure chart exports), to integrations (ERP, operational transfer pricing, Excel interface, DocuSign, SSO identity providers, e-mail reminders), to the AI runtime (R-AI assistant, AI writing service, machine translation engine) and to internal operations (full-service delivery workspace, country regulations content back office, support and onboarding). ISO 27001-certified SaaS with no installation. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The Reptune.net browser workspace, one sub-channel per functional area: model and data, the report generator, workflow and dashboard, CbCR, the legal module, benchmarks and account administration. No installation; clients are up and running in days; ISO 27001-certified hosting.

Where the transfer pricing model is configured once - legal entities, company types, functional analyses, methods and benchmarks - and where intercompany transactions, segmented financials and Excel bulk uploads are maintained and validated.

usedInProducts.description: The intelligent transfer pricing data model at the heart of every plan: entities, company types, functional analyses, methods and benchmarks configured once and reused everywhere.
